### 60-Second Onam Program Promo Script
<!-- scene-id: scene-8aec0c33-1cb5-4477-b063-02a227f8252a -->
### **[0–6 sec | Soft Kerala instrumental music, temple bells, floral visuals]**

**Background Voiceover:**

“This Thiruvonam, let’s come together to celebrate the colours, traditions, and happiness of Kerala, right here in Whitefield.”
**Music:** End with a powerful **Chendamelam beat followed by festive cheers.**

<!-- scene-id: scene-ae99f1ee-e5f5-4da5-9997-0849198f5e99 -->
### **[6–15 sec | Music slowly builds, visuals of Pookalam, traditional attire, families gathering]**

**Background VOICEOVER:**

“Whitefield Malayali Social Club proudly welcomes you to a vibrant Onam celebration filled with culture, togetherness, and unforgettable moments.”

<!-- scene-id: scene-a4ea2bdb-46c5-44dc-a1a9-8e90723ad029 -->
### **[15–28 sec | Chendamelam begins, energetic cultural visuals]**

**Background VOICEOVER:**

“Feel the energy of traditional **Chendamelam**, enjoy spectacular cultural performances, music, dance, and the beautiful traditions that make Onam so special.”

<!-- scene-id: scene-6a710e96-be0e-4694-981e-caf097636274 -->
### **[28–40 sec | Show Kathakali, Mohiniyattam, children, families celebrating]**

**Background VOICEOVER:**

“From colourful performances to laughter with friends and family, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.”

<!-- scene-id: scene-4d57e954-369e-4faa-9bcb-3830b35badee -->
### **[40–50 sec | Sadhya visuals, banana leaf, traditional dishes being served]**

**Background VOICEOVER:**

“And of course, no Onam is complete without a delicious traditional **Onam Sadhya**, served with the authentic flavours of Kerala.”

<!-- scene-id: scene-4b7ef057-4453-4d9b-989e-29fa592bd966 -->
### **[50–60 sec | Chendamelam reaches an energetic climax, group celebration visual]**

**Background VOICEOVER:**

“So wear your Kerala best, bring your family and friends, and celebrate this Thiruvonam with us. Culture. Sadhya. Music. Joy. Togetherness.”

<!-- scene-id: scene-7db4983b-0c3d-4d36-8799-c2e5bf5bcdfa -->
### **On-screen ending:**
<!-- scene-id: scene-75db8f0b-7b30-4d51-b354-480b4833611f -->
### **THIRUVONAM CELEBRATION 2026**
<!-- scene-id: scene-b0306f1a-db73-4f9e-80f4-eed9b0466116 -->
### **Whitefield Malayali Social Club**

**Together • Connected • Cultured**

<!-- scene-id: scene-68c6c851-3973-4b26-bb88-72baf364b0dc -->
### **Music:** End with a powerful **Chendamelam beat followed by festive cheers.**

assets.name: Families
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A group consisting of South Asian adults in their late 30s and early 60s with warm, golden-brown skin tones and dark brown eyes. The men are lean with neatly groomed black mustaches and short-cropped black hair, while the women have long, thick black hair styled in low buns adorned with fresh white jasmine strings. Their features are soft and rounded, reflecting a range of healthy body types and varying heights.
assets.clothingAccessories: Women wear cream-colored cotton Kasavu sarees with thick metallic gold borders and matching short-sleeved blouses. Men wear crisp white cotton Mundu dhotis with gold brocade edges and short-sleeved white button-up shirts. Small gold stud earrings and thin gold necklaces are visible on the women.
assets.backstory: These are residents of the Whitefield neighborhood in Bengaluru who have relocated from various districts in Kerala. They maintain a strong connection to their heritage by organizing large-scale communal cultural events.

assets.name: Children
assets.physicalCharacteristics: South Asian children ranging from 6 to 10 years old with radiant tan skin and large, expressive dark eyes. The girls have black hair tied in high ponytails with yellow marigold accents, and the boys have short, messy black hair with side-swept bangs. They have small, lithe frames and energetic facial expressions.
assets.clothingAccessories: Girls wear Pattu Pavada sets consisting of silk emerald green long skirts with gold patterns and cream-colored silk tops. Boys wear miniature white cotton Mundus with gold borders and simple white cotton shirts. Some children wear small black bindis on their foreheads.
assets.backstory: Raised in an urban tech hub, these children are learning about their ancestral traditions through the annual Thiruvonam festivities. They participate in the Pookalam flower carpet competitions and traditional games.

assets.name: Kathakali Performers
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Tall, muscular South Asian men with faces entirely covered in thick, vibrant green Paccha makeup and white rice-paste ridges called Chutti. Their eyes are reddened using Cunda Poovu seeds to contrast against the heavy black kohl outlining their lids. Their natural physical form is sturdy and athletic to support the weight of their elaborate costumes.
assets.clothingAccessories: They wear massive, tiered circular wooden headdresses gilded in gold and inlaid with green and red stones. The costume features oversized white billowing skirts, heavy red tunics, and massive multi-layered beaded necklaces made of wood and silver. Thick silver anklets with loud brass bells are strapped to their calves.
assets.backstory: These are highly trained classical artists who have studied at prestigious institutions like Kerala Kalamandalam for over a decade. They specialize in the physical storytelling of ancient epics through precise hand gestures and facial movements.

assets.name: Mohiniyattam Performers
assets.physicalCharacteristics: These South Asian women in their mid-twenties possess lean, athletic builds and expressive almond-shaped eyes lined with thick black kohl. Their long, jet-black hair is pulled back into a tight, smooth side bun positioned on the left side of the head, encircled by a thick garland of fresh white jasmine blossoms. Each performer features a large, perfectly circular red bindi in the center of their forehead and intricate red floral patterns in alta staining their fingertips and the centers of their palms.
assets.clothingAccessories: They wear traditional off-white cotton Kasavu sarees featuring wide, shimmering gold brocade borders and a distinctive pleated front fan, paired with matching white blouses with gold trim. The ensemble is accessorized with heavy gold temple jewelry including tiered coin necklaces, ornate bell-shaped Jhimki earrings, a wide embossed gold waist belt, and thick brass bells strapped around their ankles over bare feet.
assets.backstory: These professional dancers have spent years mastering the subtle, rhythmic movements of the Dance of the Enchantress specifically for the Whitefield Malayali Social Club cultural showcase. They serve as cultural ambassadors representing the preservation of Kerala's classical arts within the modern community during the 2026 Thiruvonam festival.
assets.physical Characteristics: South Asian women in their early 20s with slender, graceful builds and elongated limbs. Their faces are painted with bright yellow-toned foundation, featuring heavy black winged eyeliner and a prominent red bindi in the center of the forehead. Their black hair is gathered into a voluminous side bun on the left side of the head, encircled by a thick ring of white jasmine flowers.

assets.name: Whitefield
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A bustling urban residential suburb featuring wide asphalt roads lined with modern glass-fronted tech parks and high-rise luxury apartment complexes. Large green patches of manicured landscaping and mature trees frame the skyline, while vibrant street-side flower stalls and colorful local market stalls provide a burst of organic texture. The area is characterized by a mix of contemporary steel-and-concrete architecture and paved pedestrian walkways populated by people in diverse attire.
assets.timeOfDay: Bright mid-morning sunlight providing high visibility and sharp shadows.

assets.name: Whitefield Malayali Social Club
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A spacious 50-foot by 80-foot open-concept community hall featuring polished light-colored granite floors and white plastered walls decorated with vibrant floral Pookalam designs. The ceiling is high with exposed wooden beams adorned with hanging marigold garlands and traditional brass lamps (Nilavilakku) placed at key intervals. Long rows of low wooden tables are set up for Sadhya, while a raised wooden stage at the far end is equipped with professional stage lights and sound equipment for Chendamelam performances.
assets.timeOfDay: Late morning to early afternoon with warm, diffused indoor lighting and natural sunlight streaming through large side windows.

assets.name: Pookalam
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A five-foot wide circular floor mosaic composed of concentric rings of fresh botanical elements including vibrant orange marigold petals, deep crimson hibiscus fragments, and bright yellow chrysanthemum heads. The innermost circle features a precise geometric star pattern made of white jasmine buds and finely shredded green palm fronds, all exhibiting a velvety texture and moist, dew-kissed sheen.

assets.name: Chenda Drums
assets.physicalCharacteristics: Cylindrical percussion instruments constructed from hollowed, polished jackfruit wood with a deep amber-red lacquer finish. Each drum features a stark white cowhide drumhead stretched tautly over both ends, secured by a complex network of thick, braided hemp ropes and knotted leather tensioners that show slight wear and sweat staining.

assets.name: Banana Leaf
assets.physicalCharacteristics: An oversized, vibrant emerald-green frond measuring three feet in length with a prominent, rigid central midrib and soft, flexible lateral veins. The surface is glossy and waxy with a slight natural ribbing, featuring clean-cut tapered ends and a subtle gradient of lime green at the youngest edges.

assets.name: Onam Sadhya
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A multi-textured culinary arrangement featuring mounds of short-grain white matta rice topped with thick, golden-yellow dhal and a dollop of translucent ghee. Surrounding the rice are viscous dollops of bright purple beetroot khichadi, matte-finished orange avial with visible drumstick pieces, and crispy, sun-dried yellow banana chips, all arranged in a precise clockwise sequence.

frames.sceneTitle: **THIRUVONAM CELEBRATION 2026**
frames.title: The Grand Arrival
frames.visualDescription: A wide shot of the Whitefield Malayali Social Club entrance, beautifully decorated for Onam. Families dressed in traditional Kerala attire are seen entering the venue, greeted by a large and intricate Pookalam on the floor. In the background, the vibrant colors of the floral arrangement contrast with the white and gold of the traditional clothing.
frames.audioDescription: Ambient sounds of festive chatter and laughter fill the air. The faint, rhythmic sound of Chenda Drums can be heard approaching from a distance.
frames.motionDescription: The camera slowly zooms in toward the Pookalam, focusing on the intricate floral patterns as people walk past.

frames.sceneTitle: **THIRUVONAM CELEBRATION 2026**
frames.title: Cultural Performance
frames.visualDescription: On the main stage of the club, Kathakali Performers and Mohiniyattam Performers are mid-performance. The Kathakali performer shows an intense expression, while the Mohiniyattam dancers move gracefully beside him. Children sit in the front row, mesmerized by the colorful costumes and storytelling.
frames.audioDescription: The sound of traditional music with rhythmic bells and vocal chanting accompanies the dance. The atmosphere is filled with a sense of cultural reverence.
frames.motionDescription: A slow pan from left to right across the stage, capturing the contrast between the sharp Kathakali movements and the fluid Mohiniyattam dance.

frames.sceneTitle: **THIRUVONAM CELEBRATION 2026**
frames.title: The Grand Finale
frames.visualDescription: A close-up of a Banana Leaf being served with a rich Onam Sadhya. The camera then pulls back to reveal a group of people playing Chenda Drums in a high-energy circle. The scene is full of movement, joy, and the energy of a community united in celebration.
frames.audioDescription: A powerful, thunderous Chendamelam beat reaches its crescendo. This is immediately followed by a massive, synchronized burst of festive cheers and applause from the crowd.
frames.motionDescription: The camera starts as a close-up on the food and then quickly dollies back and tilts up to capture the drummer's intense performance.
